annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear condition under which a client must treat a push stream as a connection error: when no MAX_PUSH_ID frame has been sent or when the Push ID is greater than the maximum Push ID. These conditions are unambiguous and do not allow for multiple materially different interpretations. The language is precise and does not leave room for ambiguity in implementation behavior.
